basic_info.description: Updated single-family home perched atop the coveted northeast ridge of Rutledge and Franconia in one of Bernal Heights' most desirable locations. Enjoy views of downtown from all three floors as well as views of Sutro tower and the Bay. The property has four spacious bedrooms, three fully remodeled bathrooms and updated finishes throughout. Additional highlights include a rare two-car, side by side garage along with a lovely backyard. New roof, HVAC system with air conditioning, new windows throughout.     The heart of the home features a fully renovated kitchen perfect for entertaining, while the expansive upstairs living/family room opens onto a private deckideal for enjoying morning coffee or evening sunsets. Easy access to Precita Park Cafe and Park and the freeway.
